skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply basic knowledge about data querying, database design.
Understand and explain relationships within databases, normalize data up to 3NF.
Apply relational algebra expressions, SQL syntax to analyze, evaluate and explain query optimization and data integrity issues.
Understand and use basic MS SQL Server database management system.
Possess ability to build normalized databases and apply basic principles of database design process for operational activities.
Possess ability to approach different database models, analyze, advise and support digital transformation processes regarding data digitization.
Possess ability to work independently or actively, effectively participate in group activities.
Possess ability to organize group activities.
Possess social responsibility and professional ethics in the field of Information Systems Management.
